system.description:
Courters are the descendants of Tallemar - demonic shapeshifters who stole first the hearts, then the souls of their victims. Courters are often considered divinely persuasive, and they have a unique curse - they are immortal until they fall in love, at which time they soulbond to their partner, living until their partner dies.

Size: Medium (5–6 feet) · Lifespan: Immortal until bonded, then the lifespan of their partner

Abilities: @UUID[Compendium.sacadia.heritages.Item.f6847b8981262a41]{Changing Physicality}

Daemonai Heritage. Rulebook p.86.
system.lifespan: Immortal until bonded, then the lifespan of their partner
